title: Numbers and Days of the Week
subtitle: Counting, dates, and the calendar — for English learners

sentences.en: Let's count from one to ten: one, two, three, four, five.
sentences.target: Let's count from one to ten: one, two, three, four, five.

sentences.en: Six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Very good!
sentences.target: Six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Very good!

sentences.en: What day is it today? Today is Monday.
sentences.target: What day is it today? Today is Monday.

sentences.en: Yesterday was Sunday and tomorrow is Tuesday.
sentences.target: Yesterday was Sunday and tomorrow is Tuesday.

sentences.en: The days of the week are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.
sentences.target: The days of the week are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.

sentences.en: Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.
sentences.target: Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.

sentences.en: I work five days a week and rest on Saturday and Sunday.
sentences.target: I work five days a week and rest on Saturday and Sunday.

sentences.en: What is the date today? It's the fifteenth of March.
sentences.target: What is the date today? It's the fifteenth of March.

sentences.en: My birthday is on the twentieth of June.
sentences.target: My birthday is on the twentieth of June.
